mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, coupled with rising GDP (GDPC1), indicates strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong growth signals, or correlation between HOUST and GDPC1 drops below 0.4 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A steady federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other economic conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.2%, accompanied by increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS), signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite strong labor market signals, or correlation between UNRATE and PAYEMS drops below 0.5 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY, without significant inflation (CPIAUCSL < 3% YoY), indicates sustainable supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth < 3%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite sustainable supply growth, or INDPRO's correlation with CPIAUCSL becomes significantly positive over any 1.5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) above $380 billion, coupled with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%), indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong demand signals, or RSAFS's correlation with UNRATE drops below 0.3 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 1.5% in 3 months signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite tightening signals, or FEDFUNDS's correlation with SPX returns becomes significantly positive over any 1.5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Steady payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth above 100,000 jobs per month, without rising unemployment (UNRATE), indicates a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, regardless of other economic conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in healthy labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) decline below -1% YoY, accompanied by rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY), signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY decline < -1% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite disruption signals, or INDPRO's correlation with CPIAUCSL becomes significantly negative over any 1.5-year window.
